objects.name: ARTEX Moves at Machine Speed: What Risk Owners Need to Change
objects.description: Key Takeaways ARTEX, an AI-driven penetration-testing framework released in July 2026, doesn’t exploit new kinds of vulnerabilities. It automates the discovery, chaining, and retrying of existing weaknesses, often across many targets at once.
